name: Haufe X360
description: Haufe X360 cloud ERP (the German Acumatica edition): customers, vendors, stock items, sales orders, A/R invoices and shipments over the contract-based REST API. Session login with an X360 user. Read-only.
instructions:
**What this connects to.** Haufe X360 is built on Acumatica, and every X360 tenant comes with Acumatica's predefined **Default** web service endpoint. This connector reads it at `<your X360 address>/entity/Default/<version>`, logging in with a normal X360 user.

**Setup**
1. Ask your X360 administrator or Haufe partner for a dedicated user for the integration, with the roles for the screens it should read (customers, vendors, stock items, sales orders, invoices, shipments). Acumatica checks the same access rights as in the browser. The licence limits how many API sessions may be open at once; the connector keeps one session and reuses it.
2. Set `X360_URL` to the address you open X360 with in the browser, up to but not including `/Main` or `/Frames`, with no trailing slash.
3. Set `X360_TENANT` to the tenant (company) name you pick on the login screen.
4. Set `X360_ENDPOINT_VERSION` to a version of the Default endpoint listed on the **Web Service Endpoints** form (SM207060), e.g. `20.200.001`, `23.200.001` or `24.200.001`. The fields these tools use are the same in all of them.
5. Set `X360_USERNAME` and `X360_PASSWORD`.

**Session.** The connector signs in at `/entity/auth/login` and sends the session cookies back on every call. When the session expires, it signs in again.

**Values come wrapped.** Every field arrives as `{"value": ...}`, and field names are the ones the screens show: `CustomerID`, `CustomerName`, `OrderNbr`, `ReferenceNbr`.

**Query options.** List tools take `$filter` (OData syntax, e.g. `Status eq 'Open'`), `$top`, `$skip`, `$select` and `$expand`. Always pass `top` on a first call: without it the API returns every record. `expand=Details` adds the lines of an order or invoice; without it you get the header only.

**Read-only by design**: no tool creates, changes or releases a document.

X360_URL.label: X360 address
X360_URL.help: The address you open Haufe X360 with in the browser, up to but not including /Main, with no trailing slash.

X360_TENANT.label: Tenant
X360_TENANT.help: The tenant (company) name you choose on the X360 login screen.

X360_ENDPOINT_VERSION.label: Default endpoint version
X360_ENDPOINT_VERSION.help: A version of the Default endpoint listed on the Web Service Endpoints form (SM207060) of your X360.
X360_ENDPOINT_VERSION.patternMessage: Use the version as the Web Service Endpoints form shows it, e.g. 24.200.001.

tools.name: haufe_x360_list_customers
tools.description: List customers with their customer id, name, status, customer class and payment terms.

top.description: Maximum rows to return. Always set it on a first call.

expand.description: Related records to include, e.g. MainContact for the address and contact details.

tools.name: haufe_x360_get_customer
tools.description: Read one customer by customer id. Expand MainContact for the address, Contacts for the contact people and CreditVerificationRules for the credit settings.

customerId.description: Customer id as the screen shows it, e.g. C000001.

tools.name: haufe_x360_list_sales_orders
tools.description: List sales orders with order type and number, customer, date, status and order total. expand=Details adds the lines.

top.description: Maximum rows to return. Always set it on a first call.

expand.description: Related records to include; Details returns the line items.

tools.name: haufe_x360_list_stock_items
tools.description: List stock items with inventory id, description, item class, base unit, default price and item status.

top.description: Maximum rows to return. Always set it on a first call.

tools.name: haufe_x360_list_invoices
tools.description: List A/R invoices and credit memos with type, reference number, customer, date, due date, status, amount and open balance: the answer to what is still open.

top.description: Maximum rows to return. Always set it on a first call.

expand.description: Related records to include; Details returns the lines.

tools.name: haufe_x360_list_shipments
tools.description: List shipments with shipment number, type, customer, shipment date and status. expand=Orders shows the sales orders each one fulfils.

top.description: Maximum rows to return. Always set it on a first call.

expand.description: Related records to include, e.g. Orders or Details.

tools.name: haufe_x360_list_vendors
tools.description: List vendors with vendor id, name, status, vendor class and payment terms, for the purchasing side.

top.description: Maximum rows to return. Always set it on a first call.

select.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. VendorID,VendorName,Status,VendorClass.

expand.description: Related records to include, e.g. MainContact.
